input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including users, role. The platform provides capabilities for custom user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage users records, so that I can track and organize users data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage role records, so that I can track and organize role data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with hello resource functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello resource-related tasks.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
